The '''cybernetic nexus ring''' was a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] power interface manufactured by [[Menendahl Cybertronics]]. Resembling a [[Signet ring/Legends|signet ring]], the top of the nexus ring could be flipped up to reveal a chemically-coated [[monofilament fiber]] with an [[energy jack connector]]. The ring also had a power cord that could plug directly into [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] attachments such as prosthetics. The ring could be plugged into a power source and energy stored in an internal [[Battery/Legends|battery]], or transferred directly into a cybernetic attachment. The ring's [[energy converter]] adjusted the power flow to boost the performance of the attached prosthetic.
